claims.description: Ordinary structural elements participate in supported block flow.

notes.text: The layout tree gives ordinary elements the same default block style unless author CSS overrides them.

claims.description: Text-oriented block elements receive a narrow set of user-agent spacing and text defaults.

notes.text: `address`, `p`, headings, `blockquote`, `figure`, and `pre` receive a narrow set of user-agent text metrics and spacing defaults.

claims.description: `details` and `summary` elements expose supported open and closed layout behavior.

notes.text: Closed `details` content is suppressed from layout and hit testing; Chromium still exposes non-zero rectangles for suppressed descendants, which this engine does not model.

claims.description: Basic `dialog` open and closed state controls box generation.

notes.text: Native `dialog` centering, modal top-layer behavior, and `::backdrop` are not modeled.

claims.description: The hidden attribute suppresses supported element layout.

notes.text: Both ordinary `hidden` and `hidden=until-found` have parity coverage for supported box suppression.
